ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; remind the driver that "I'm Here" must be pressed to support a no-show cancellation (RD-6/NS-2 flag not triggered on this record).

rejected_claims.reason: Driver states he waited 4 minutes and cancelled as a no-show, but the trip record shows no 'I'm Here' press (driver_pressed_here_at null, wait_started_at null) and the GPS trace shows him only entering the pickup radius around 22:41, so NS-1 (i)/(ii) are unmet and NS-2 requires a full refund.
